method: public DNS answers from Google DNS-over-HTTPS, read-only
findings: The authoritative DNS is Jimdo; provider-side Cloudflare IPs and headers do not prove a user-managed Cloudflare zone.
A normal Workers Route needs control of the matching active zone and a proxied DNS record.
The mail exchangers also point to Jimdo. No DNS or nameserver change was attempted.
A free full-zone setup would require a separately reviewed nameserver and complete DNS migration. A partial CNAME setup is not available on Cloudflare Free or Pro.
The registrar, account access, complete DNS zone, DNSSEC and origin-proxy compatibility are not established by these public answers.
